watch.summary: The creator looks away for a second during a Rocket League match and immediately gets scored on, resulting in an explosive reaction.

beats.what: Creator drives towards the ball in Rocket League.
The opponent suddenly blasts the ball into the creator's goal.
The goal is scored instantly and creator screams in shock.
Creator laughs in disbelief at how fast the opponent scored while he looked away.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The instant punishment for momentarily taking his eyes off the game provides great comedic timing. His high-pitched scream and genuine disbelief make the sudden mistake relatable and funny.
